sources.title: Append (Feature Service/Layer) — ArcGIS REST APIs
sources.version_or_commit: Living ArcGIS Enterprise REST API documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; page contains version-gated behavior, including imageCollection at 11.5 and appendItemId at Enterprise 10.9.
sources.locator: “Supported append formats”, Append capability/privileges, appendSourceInfo for CSV, upsert, CSV-to-table example, and “Appending image collections”.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Esri REST API page in the T3 collaborative browser and read supported formats, capability/privilege, source parsing, upsert, CSV example, and imageCollection behavior. The browser did not expose a per-request UTC timestamp; access_utc is the following clock observation after the reviser retrieval batch.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ArcGIS Online and Enterprise feature service layers can support Append; the target advertises supportsAppend/supportedAppendFormats, and nonadministrative callers need the Append capability/privilege while service owner/organization admins can use it without that capability enabled. CSV is a supported format when advertised; CSV parsing uses appendSourceInfo. Upsert may update matching rows. Since 11.5, imageCollection append can create points from EXIF location and attach the image.
sources.applicability: A possible structured-row import route into a feature service, not a Survey123-native import or a tested workflow. The CSV schema, service version, identity, no-overwrite behavior, attachments, and permissions must be validated. Avoid imageCollection for this brief because it infers location from photos.
